units.source_text: “这是承蒙先生夸奖过的婴儿……”夫人说着指了指一位少年。

en.t: "This is the baby you were kind enough to praise..." the lady said, pointing to a boy.

units.source_text: 她还提醒孩子说：“你还是婴儿时，浦上先生就在报上表扬了你，不是吗？”

en.t: She also reminded the child, "When you were still a baby, Mr. Urakami praised you in the newspaper, didn't he?"
